Author: N.R. Borkar

 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Writ Petition No. 2646 Of 2023
 Shadab Shakeel Shaikh and others ... Petitioners
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra and another ... Respondents
 .........

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However, none appears for Respondent No.2.
Even on previous dates of hearing i.e. on 22 nd December 2023 and 23rd January 2024, none appeared for Respondent No.2.
FIR relates to the offences under Sections 498A, 406, 323, 509, 504, 506 r/w. 34 of Indian Penal Code.
On completing investigation, charge-sheet is filed.
To give one more opportunity to Respondent No.2 to appear in the proceedings, the Petition is adjourned to 20th March 2024.
In the meantime, proceedings before the trial court are stayed till further orders.

( N.R. BORKAR, J. ) ( PRAKASH D. NAIK, J. )
